package.name: amr_safety_watchdog
package.description:
Central safety arbitration node. Aggregates multiple safety sources (estop, lidar_safety, bumper, motor_fault, etc.) via AND logic and publishes /safe_to_move (std_msgs/Bool) at 10Hz as a dead man's switch.
This is the SINGLE publisher of /safe_to_move in the workspace. Consumer nodes (e.g., action servers, motor drivers) subscribe to /safe_to_move with RELIABLE + TRANSIENT_LOCAL QoS and stop motion when data=false or topic silence exceeds timeout.
Not related to trnav_motion_supervisor (which is the mux source activator in src/Control-Abstract/trnav_motion_supervisor/).
